jurisdictions.name: Federal FOIA
jurisdictions.fee_summary: Search, review, and duplication fees may apply. News media, education, and noncommercial scientific requesters are in a favorable fee category. Anyone may request a public-interest fee waiver.
jurisdictions.exemptions_note: Nine exemptions in 5 U.S.C. § 552(b). See FOIA.gov.

jurisdictions.name: Alabama Open Records Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the records officer of the county, city, school district, or other local body that holds the records. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: Alaska Public Records Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the records officer of the local body that holds the records. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: Arizona Public Records Law
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the records officer of the local body that holds the records. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: Arkansas Freedom of Information Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the custodian of the local body that holds the records. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: California Public Records Act
jurisdictions.fee_summary: Copying costs may apply. Direct costs of duplication are typical; agencies may not charge extra for making the records available for inspection.
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Each city, county, and special district has its own PRA contact. Ask that body; do not send local requests only to the Attorney General.
jurisdictions.exemptions_note: Many exemptions in the PRA; see Division 10. The Legislature has a separate Legislative Open Records Act.

jurisdictions.name: Colorado Open Records Act (CORA)
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the records custodian of the local body that holds the records. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: Connecticut Freedom of Information Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the public agency that holds the records. The FOI Commission hears appeals.

jurisdictions.name: Delaware Freedom of Information Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the FOIA coordinator of the public body that holds the records. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: Florida Public Records Law
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Every Florida agency and local government must provide public records. Ask the clerk or records custodian of that body.

jurisdictions.name: Georgia Open Records Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the open records officer of the local body. This site does not list local contacts.
jurisdictions.exemptions_note: The General Assembly is not covered the same way as executive agencies. See the statute.

jurisdictions.name: Hawaii Uniform Information Practices Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the agency that holds the records. OIP provides guidance and can hear appeals.

jurisdictions.name: Idaho Public Records Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the public records custodian of the local body. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: Illinois Freedom of Information Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Each public body has a FOIA officer. Send the request to that body. The Attorney General Public Access Counselor hears many disputes.

jurisdictions.name: Indiana Access to Public Records Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the public agency that holds the records. The Public Access Counselor provides informal opinions.

jurisdictions.name: Iowa Open Records Law
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the lawful custodian of the local body. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: Kansas Open Records Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the freedom of information officer of the public agency. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: Kentucky Open Records Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the official custodian of the local body. The Attorney General issues open-records decisions.

jurisdictions.name: Louisiana Public Records Law
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the custodian of the public body that holds the records. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: Maine Freedom of Access Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the public access officer of the local body. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: Maryland Public Information Act
jurisdictions.statute_citation: Md. Code Ann., Gen. Prov. § 4-101 et seq.
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the PIA representative of the local body. This site does not list local contacts.
jurisdictions.exemptions_note: See the PIA manual on the Attorney General site.

jurisdictions.name: Massachusetts Public Records Law
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the records access officer of the local body. The Supervisor of Records hears many appeals.

jurisdictions.name: Michigan Freedom of Information Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the FOIA coordinator of the local public body. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: Minnesota Government Data Practices Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Ask the responsible authority of the government entity that holds the data. This site does not list local contacts.
jurisdictions.exemptions_note: Data are classified as public, private, or confidential. See ch. 13.

jurisdictions.name: Mississippi Public Records Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the public body that holds the records. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: Missouri Sunshine Law
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the custodian of records of the public governmental body. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: Montana Public Records Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: The Montana Constitution also guarantees a right to examine government documents. Ask the local body that holds the records.

jurisdictions.name: Nebraska Public Records Statutes
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the official custodian of the local body. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: Nevada Public Records Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the records official of the local government. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: New Hampshire Right-to-Know Law
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the public body that holds the records. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: New Jersey Open Public Records Act (OPRA)
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Use the official OPRA form and send it to the records custodian of the agency or local unit. The Government Records Council hears many complaints.

jurisdictions.name: New Mexico Inspection of Public Records Act (IPRA)
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the records custodian of the public body. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: New York Freedom of Information Law (FOIL)
jurisdictions.statute_citation: N.Y. Pub. Off. Law § 84 et seq.
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send a FOIL request to the records access officer of the local agency. The Committee on Open Government issues advisory opinions.

jurisdictions.name: North Carolina Public Records Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: No special form is required. Ask the agency that has the records. Keep a written copy.

jurisdictions.name: North Dakota Open Records Law
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the public entity that holds the records. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: Ohio Public Records Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: No special form is required. Ask the public office that has the records.

jurisdictions.name: Oklahoma Open Records Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the public body that holds the records. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: Oregon Public Records Law
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the public body that holds the records. The Attorney General publishes a public records manual.

jurisdictions.name: Pennsylvania Right-to-Know Law
jurisdictions.local_how_to: File with the open-records officer of the local agency. OOR hears many appeals.

jurisdictions.name: Rhode Island Access to Public Records Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the public body that holds the records. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: South Carolina Freedom of Information Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the public body that holds the records. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: South Dakota Open Records Law
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the public record officer of the local body. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: Tennessee Public Records Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the public records request coordinator of the local body. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: Texas Public Information Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the officer for public information of the governmental body. The Attorney General decides many withholding disputes.
jurisdictions.exemptions_note: See Gov't Code ch. 552, Subchapter C.

jurisdictions.name: Utah Government Records Access and Management Act (GRAMA)
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send a GRAMA request to the records officer of the governmental entity. This site does not list local contacts.
jurisdictions.exemptions_note: Records are classified public, private, controlled, or protected.

jurisdictions.name: Vermont Public Records Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the custodian of the public agency. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: Virginia Freedom of Information Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the FOIA officer of the public body. The FOIA Council provides opinions.

jurisdictions.name: Washington Public Records Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the public records officer of the local agency. Agencies cannot require a particular form.

jurisdictions.name: West Virginia Freedom of Information Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the public body that holds the records. This site does not list local contacts.

jurisdictions.name: Wisconsin Public Records Law
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the authority that holds the records. DOJ publishes an Open Government compliance guide.

jurisdictions.name: Wyoming Public Records Act
jurisdictions.local_how_to: Send the request to the designated public records person of the governmental entity. This site does not list local contacts.
